_regions.H: head: crown, nape, cheeks and throat (a paler, greyer blue than the body)
_regions.W: wing: folded wing, shoulder to the primary tips (the most vivid blue)
_regions.T: tail: upper surface, solid 2 px wide below row 17
_regions.U: undertail coverts and the underside at the tail base (rows 12-17 only; the lower tail is solid T)
_regions.K: beak: upper mandible, the hooked arc (slate grey, lifted above the head blue in luminance)
_regions.k: beak: lower mandible, inside the hook (darker grey)
_regions.Y: lappet: bare yellow skin at the base of the lower mandible
_regions.R: eye ring: bare yellow skin behind the eye
_regions.P: perch: the broken branch the bird grips
